comments.author: @33samogo
comments.text:
Obviousness is subjective not objective fact, one can see something that another fails to see, even though the other is a greater expert in the particular technology field as someone who saw the solution at first sight! Similar happens to me constantly when I'm working on an invention, when I can't see a solution, I put the project aside for a certain time, when I come back to the project, I see obvious things that I didn't see before and that leads me to a solution. But during my absence, I did not think about the project or upgrade my knowledge in the field of technology, I diverted my thoughts elsewhere and returned to the project unencumbered. I'm always surprised that I haven't seen obvious solution before, it is a nightmare, because during this period of absence years can pass.

If your climes are ABCD this does not mean that you invent A,B,C,D elements, all elements are known already, you just combine them together in specific configuration to create something new. It is impossible or very difficult today to invent new elements! If examiner did not find CD searching on similar climes this does not mean that CD don't exist in the field of your invention.

But on the other hand you work hard to come up with ABCD clime and someone will add E to this clime to get a new ABCDE clime, if this E is obvious in my perception and not obvious in examiner perception, than this can brake your heart :)
